title: Unreal Descent 2: Race
seo_title: Unreal Descent 2: Race — Play Free Descent Racing Game Online
meta_desc: Play Unreal Descent 2: Race free online. Extreme downhill races with nitro, unique vehicles and improved 3D tracks where only speed and reaction win.
desc: Unreal Descent 2: Race is the sequel to the popular extreme-descent arcade racer, now with improved graphics, new levels and tracks, and unique vehicles that make every race more spectacular. Each descent is a survival race: gas, brake, nitro and nerve as you plunge down treacherous courses where only speed and reaction carry you to the finish first. Switch between views, pick your machine, and get ready for a real high-speed descent.
howto: The game loads automatically when you open the page — just wait a moment.
Gas with W or the up arrow, brake with S or the down arrow.
Turn with A/D or the left and right arrows.
Hit C for nitro when the track straightens out.
Press F to change camera view mid-race.
Cross the finish line first to win the descent.

controls.key: A / D or Left / Right arrows

tips: Save nitro for straight sections — boosting through bends wastes it in the barriers.
Braking into a descent corner is faster than flying off it.
Learn each track's rhythm in the first lap, then attack on the second.
Switch views (F) until one gives you readable depth on steep drops.

faqs.question: What is Unreal Descent 2: Race?
faqs.answer: Unreal Descent 2: Race is a free browser racing game about extreme downhill courses, featuring improved graphics, new tracks, unique vehicles, nitro boosts and multiple camera views.

faqs.question: How do I use nitro in Unreal Descent 2: Race?
faqs.answer: Press C to fire the nitro once your speed is up — it is most effective on straight sections where the extra pace will not throw you off the track.

faqs.question: Does it work on phones?
faqs.answer: Yes — on phones the game provides an on-screen steering wheel and buttons so you can gas, brake and steer with touch controls.
